d:
Bihar ki rajniti men vidhan parishad ke do nirdaliy sadasyon banshidhar brajvasi aur rahul raj ke bijepi men shamil hone ke bad sadasyata ko lekar vivad tej ho gaya hai. neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne vidhan parishad ke sabhapti se mulakat kar donon netaon ki sadasyata radd karne ki mang uthaee. aakhir is mamle men tejasvi yadav ne sabhapti ke samne kya dalil di aur bijepi men shamil hone ke bad donon MLC ki sadasyata par kyon uth rahe hain saval? dekhie puri riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
